note: V1-A adjacency-specific transfer probe. At sampled boundaries, apply one fixed-OSOA update then FREEZE and score the true future window [k+1,k+h_max] and K matched non-adjacent same-domain controls under the pre/post-update model; T = G_adj - G_ctrl isolates adjacency-specific gain from generic domain adaptation. The main trajectory is plain OSOA (byte-identical, determinism preserved); only frozen forwards are added, so cost is ~1x a plain run plus one base pre-pass (much cheaper than the branching probe). Fixed r32/alpha64/ep3/ti1, lr=1e-4 (best fixed OSOA), compress-only. Controls are difficulty-matched (static-NLL decile) + non-adjacent (>=2*h_max) + non-overlapping; doc/session/file matching is NOT applied (concatenated streams carry no such labels). n_target=128 is a target; small datasets yield fewer well-spaced boundaries. Analyse with evaluation/adjacency_curve.py (pooled + per-dataset T_pct/G_adj/T_share, block bootstrap, sign-flip permutation, PASS/SIGNIFICANT-BUT-SMALL/FAIL). loghub and codesearchnet are the high-adjacency candidates most likely to show T>0; enwik9/beancounter/pile_of_law are the prose controls. adjacency_probe is mutually exclusive with measure_gk and branch_lrs. lora_r fixed -> alpha=2*r.
